decisions.decision: Delta spec uses MODIFIED against a git-mv'd specs folder, not ADDED+REMOVED
decisions.why: The ADDED path makes the archiver synthesize a TBD Purpose and orphan an empty battery/ husk. MODIFIED keeps the hand-written Purpose; cost is one hard-ordered task (3.1).

decisions.decision: Wave-1 file moves use plain mv, not git mv; the leader stages
decisions.why: tasks.md told the module worker to run git mv, which write-ownership forbids. Git stores no renames, so mv + git add -A yields an identical commit and blame.

decisions.decision: Accepted the worker's rename of 3 stale identifiers in history_test.go not named in the proposal
decisions.why: The file is compile-forced open anyway; leaving fakeBatteryReader et al. stale recreates the duplicate-vocabulary cost RM29 exists to remove. Names only, no assertion change.
